exposure: sufentanil added to hyperbaric bupivacaine 0.25% in transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block
outcome: postoperative visual analogue scale (VAS) for pain
cohort: Fifty ASA physical status I-II term primiparous single-tone pregnant women aged 20-40 years scheduled for elective cesarean delivery were enrolled.
finding: Sufentanil added to 0.25% hyperbaric bupivacaine in TAP block significantly decreased post-cesarean delivery morphine consumption compared to placebo.
mod_finding: The addition of sufentanil to TAP block decreases post-cesarean delivery morphine consumption.
